name: Texture Atlasing for Draw-Call Reduction
description: Pack many small unique textures into a single atlas so multiple meshes can share one material and be drawn in one batch.
when_to_use: Environments with many small props (foliage, debris, rubble) that share an art style.
conceptual_steps: Group props by material family (e.g. all rusted metal, all sandstone).
Pack into 2048×2048 atlases with 4-pixel padding to prevent mip bleed.
Adjust UVs of source meshes to point into the atlas region.
Verify draw call count drops in the renderer profiler.
tradeoffs: Higher per-texture memory; harder to update a single prop without re-baking the atlas.
references: Unity Manual: Sprite Atlas / Mesh Combine
